Version Control

تكديس التصحيحات

A sequential arrangement of dependent patches, managed to be applied, rebased, or merged in order to a codebase, ensuring controlled integration.

Definition

A sequential arrangement of dependent patches, managed to be applied, rebased, or merged in order to a codebase, ensuring controlled integration.

Operational example

Manage your patch stack to ensure each dependent patch is rebased on top of the latest integration branch before merging.

Localized term
